facts.text: I read every paper and the society pages on the boat. Good deals start on the ferry.
facts.why: Tess does commute by the Staten Island Ferry and does gatecrash Trask's daughter's wedding to pitch. No opened source says she reads the society pages on the boat.
facts.fix: Good deals start on the ferry. Mine got pitched at a wedding, uninvited.
